notes: Exact Bowers & Wilkins DB1D manufacturer information sheet. It identifies an active DB Series subwoofer with two 300 mm (12 in) Aerofoil-cone drive units in a balanced configuration and a built-in 2000 W Class D Hypex amplifier. Published response is 10–350 Hz at -3 dB, centered on the level at 100 Hz; its separate -6 dB range is 8.5–500 Hz. The database stores the specified -3 dB response limits only. Amplifier max output is not stored as speaker power handling; sensitivity and driver impedance are not published as passive-speaker specifications and remain N/A. No response points or directivity data are imported. Source: https://www.bowerswilkins.com/on/demandware.static/-/Library-Sites-bowers_northamerica_shared/default/dw0a89b49d/downloads/db1d-information-sheet.pdf.
